_comment: Guided tour for Lazy Lifetime Analysis (hand-built Qt panel, no view spec): steps target buttons by caption ('action') and output tabs ('tab'). Read by chisurf.gui.widgets.tools.guided_tour.

steps.title: One decay, one IRF, choices made by rule
steps.text:
This fits a single TCSPC decay with a few exponentials, reconvolved with a measured IRF. What makes it lazy is that the fit range, the background, the IRF shift and — if you ask — the number of components are decided by fixed rules instead of by you.

That is convenient and it is also the risk: each rule can be wrong for your data. Six steps.

steps.title: Load the decay
steps.text:
A text file with a time column in ns and a count column. Only the first two columns are read.

The plugin ships an example: chisurf/plugins/fluorescence_decay/lltf/example/5-44_D0.dat.

await.hint: Press the first Load... and pick a decay file.

steps.title: The IRF, and the settings file
steps.text:
Load the IRF the same way (second Load...; the example is IRF_D0.dat).

Edit... opens the configuration file: fit range (start_fraction, area), background window, IRF-shift grid, starting lifetimes, pile-up. Everything not on this panel lives there.

steps.title: Fix the number of lifetimes yourself
steps.text:
Start with a fixed number. Find Optimal Number of Lifetimes fits 1 … Max components and picks one, but its test needs a 14 % drop in reduced χ² at the default threshold whatever the photon count, and a failed fit with more components can make it count wrong.

Use it to see the sequence of χ², not to decide.

steps.title: Run the fit
steps.text: The fit runs in a separate process; its log appears in Analysis Output. A maxfev warning there means the optimizer ran out of evaluations rather than converging.

steps.title: Read the residuals, then move the range
steps.text:
Results shows species fractions (they sum to 1 — not intensity fractions), lifetimes, χ² and the fit range, above the fit and its weighted residuals.

Structure in the residuals means the model is wrong in a way χ² hides. Then change start_fraction or area and fit again: on the example decay the short lifetime moves from 0.78 to 1.35 ns between two reasonable ranges. A lifetime that moves with the window is not determined by the data.
